title: 第15章 她也是有学霸包袱的好吗第16章 他背后的老板和安怜的关系不一般
slug: 贵族学院平民盲女怎么成了白月光
lines: 叶闻白正站在衣帽间里换衣服，上身只穿了一件白衬衫，扣子还没扣好，露出一截精瘦的腰身。
听到安怜的声音，他转过身，看到她只穿了一件吊带睡裙，头发散在肩上，脚上套着毛绒拖鞋，看起来乖乖的。
“过来。”他说。
安怜走过去，叶闻白从衣柜里拿出一件薄外套，披在她肩上。
“早上凉，多穿点。”他说着，低头在她额头上亲了一下。
安怜有些羞，脸颊也不受控制的发热，她小声说：“我又不是小孩子。”
叶闻白唇角上扬，没说话，转身继续挑选今天要穿的领带。
安怜站在旁边，虽然看不见，但她能感知到叶闻白在做什么。
他的动作不急不慢，先拿出一条深蓝色的领带比了比，似乎不太满意，又放了回去，换了一条银灰色的，在领口比划。
“哥哥今天要出门吗？”安怜问。
“嗯，上午有个会。”叶闻白一边系领带一边说，“下午回来，陪你吃晚饭。”
安怜乖巧地点头。
叶闻白系好领带，转过身，看着安怜。
她站在那里，披着他的外套，头发有点乱，脸上还带着刚睡醒的红晕。
整个人看起来懒洋洋的，像一只餍足的小猫。
叶闻白帮她把睡裙的领口往上拉了拉。
昨晚留下的痕迹有些太明显了。
安怜感觉到他的动作，脸颊又红了几分，小声嘟囔：“都怪你。”
叶闻白挑眉：“怪我？”
“当然怪你。”安怜理直气壮地说，“我都说了不要了，你还……”
她说不下去了，声音越来越小。
叶闻白看着她这副又羞又恼的模样，心情好极了，伸手揉了揉她的发顶。
“好好好，怪我。”他说，“下次注意。”
安怜哼了一声，偏过头不看他。
虽然她本来也看不见。
叶闻白收回手，走到床边坐下，拍了拍身边的位置。
“过来坐。”
安怜慢吞吞地走过去，在叶闻白身边坐下。
叶闻白顺势揽住她的肩，让她靠在自己肩膀上，语气随意：“对了，月影回廊的事，你听说了吗？”
安怜想起昨天在翻译文稿里看到的内容，点点头：“听说了，好像是光月觉醒者才能进的秘境，里面可以学到封印之术。”
叶闻白有些意外：“你消息倒是灵通。”
安怜心虚地笑了笑，没敢说自己在翻译文稿里看到的。
“月影回廊确实对你有帮助。”叶闻白的声音不紧不慢，“你的封印考试，每次都踩线及格，我都替你捏把汗。”
要不要这么直接，她也是有学霸包袱的好吗？
“月影回廊每五年才开一次，这次的机会很难得。”叶闻白说，“我已经让人去安排了，到时候会有人专门带你去，路线、时间、需要准备的东西，都有人替你打点好。”
安怜抬起头，朝着叶闻白的方向看过去，有些不确定地问：“哥哥帮我安排好了？”
“嗯。”叶闻白语气平淡，“你第一次去秘境，一个人我不放心。那边有专人引导，你跟着走就行，不用操心别的。”
安怜心里涌起一股暖意，说不上来是什么感觉，但就是觉得鼻子有点酸。
她张了张嘴，想说谢谢，话到嘴边又觉得太生分了，于是干脆凑过去，在叶闻白脸上亲了一口。
亲完就缩了回去，假装什么事都没有发生，但红得能滴血的耳朵还是暴露了她的情绪。
content_en:
Ye Wenbai was standing in the cloakroom changing clothes. He only wore a white shirt on his upper body, which was not buttoned yet, revealing a lean waist.
Hearing An Lian's voice, he turned around and saw that she was only wearing a suspender nightgown, with her hair spread over her shoulders and plush slippers on her feet. She looked well-behaved.
"Come here," he said.
An Lian walked over, and Ye Wenbai took out a thin coat from the closet and put it on her shoulders.
"It's cold in the morning, so wear more clothes." He said, lowering his head and kissing her on the forehead.
An Lian was a little embarrassed, and her cheeks were heating up uncontrollably. She whispered, "I'm not a child."
Ye Wenbai raised the corners of his lips and said nothing. He turned around and continued to choose the tie to wear today.
An Lian stood nearby. Although she couldn't see it, she could sense what Ye Wenbai was doing.
He moved slowly and unhurriedly. He first took out a dark blue tie and compared it. He seemed to be dissatisfied, then put it back, replaced it with a silver-grey one, and marked it on the collar.
"Brother, are you going out today?" An Lian asked.
"Well, I have a meeting in the morning." Ye Wenbai said while tying his tie, "I'll be back in the afternoon and have dinner with you."
An Lian nodded obediently.
Ye Wenbai tied up his tie, turned around and looked at An Lian.
She stood there, wearing his coat, her hair a little messy, and her face still flushed from just waking up.
The whole person looks lazy, like a satisfied kitten.
Ye Wenbai helped her pull up the collar of her nightgown.
The traces left by last night were a little too obvious.
An Lian felt his movements, her cheeks turned red again, and she whispered, "It's all your fault."
Ye Wenbai raised his eyebrows: "Blame me?"
"Of course it's your fault." An Lian said confidently, "I said no more, but you still..."
She couldn't speak any more and her voice became smaller and smaller.
Ye Wenbai looked at her shy and annoyed look, felt very good, and reached out to rub the top of her hair.
"Okay, okay, blame me." He said, "Be careful next time."
An Lian snorted and turned her head away from him.
Even though she couldn't see it.
Ye Wenbai took back his hand, walked to the bed and sat down, patting the place next to him.
"Come and sit."
An Lian walked over slowly and sat down next to Ye Wenbai.
Ye Wenbai put his arm around her shoulders and asked her to lean on his shoulders. He said in a casual tone: "By the way, have you heard about the Moon Shadow Corridor?"
An Lian thought of what he saw in the translation yesterday and nodded: "I heard that it seems to be a secret realm that can only be entered by those who have awakened the light and moon, and you can learn the art of sealing in it."
Ye Wenbai was a little surprised: "You are quite well informed."
An Lian smiled guiltily, not daring to say what she saw in the translation manuscript.
"The Moon Shadow Corridor is indeed helpful to you." Ye Wenbai's voice was unhurried, "Every time you pass the sealing exam, I will sweat it for you."
An Lian: "..."
Should she be so direct? She also has the burden of being a top student, okay?
"The Moon Shadow Corridor only opens once every five years. This opportunity is rare." Ye Wenbai said, "I have already made arrangements. Someone will take you there when the time comes. The route, time, and things that need to be prepared will all be arranged for you."
An Lian raised her head, looked in the direction of Ye Wenbai, and asked with some uncertainty: "Brother, have you arranged it for me?"
"Yeah." Ye Wenbai's tone was calm, "It's your first time going to the secret realm, so I don't worry about being alone. There will be someone to guide you, so just follow along and don't worry about anything else."
An Lian felt a sense of warmth in her heart. She couldn't tell what it felt like, but she just felt her nose was a little sore.
She opened her mouth to say thank you, but the words felt too harsh when she reached her lips, so she simply leaned over and kissed Ye Wenbai on the face.
After the kiss, she pulled back, pretending that nothing happened, but her ears, which were so red that they could bleed, still betrayed her emotions.
title_en: Chapter 15 She also has the burden of being a top student, okay? Chapter 16 The boss behind him has an unusual relationship with An Lian
